thanks.title: Thank you, we have received your booking
thanks.titleIndividual: Thank you, we have received your enquiry
thanks.lead: We have sent a summary of the booking to your email.
steps: We will review your booking and confirm it by email.
The confirmation includes payment instructions. For a bank transfer, the booking number is the payment reference.
The email also contains a link to set your password for the customer area, where you can follow, change or cancel the booking.
At pick-up, please have your ID card or passport, driving licence and the deposit ready.
stepsIndividual: We will prepare an individual offer and send it to you by email.
Once you approve the price, we will confirm the booking and send payment instructions.
The email also contains a link to set your password for the customer area.
At pick-up, please have your ID card or passport, driving licence and the deposit ready.
thanks.noEmail: No email? Check your spam folder or contact us at {email}.
